title: Construction of the two section homotopies without acyclicity
statement: Let f:X→Y be a scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme], F an X-module [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], I an injective resolution of F and J an injective resolution of f_*F [def-sp-injective-resolutions]. Let K be any nonnegative complex of Y-modules, l:f_*I→K a quasi-isomorphism, and β:J→K an augmentation-compatible map, namely J.ι⁰ β⁰=f_*(I.ι⁰)l⁰. Let a:Γ(X,I)≅Γ(Y,f_*I) have inverse the canonical restriction in every degree. Using the abelian resolution R, the explicit forgotten identity lift r:T_X(I)→R and the counit section map c of [new-abelian-counit-resolution-calculation], there exists q:Γ(Y,K)→Γ(X,R) with homotopies Γ(β)q∼c and (a.hom Γ(l))q∼Γ(r). No injectivity of K and no quasi-isomorphism assertion about q is assumed or concluded.

source.place: 013P(1), lifting along a quasi-isomorphism up to homotopy; 013S, uniqueness; 01FB, common sections diagram.

proof.text: Apply the uniform common-witness theorem second_section_homotopy_of_counit before supplying a. Obtain q, its counit homotopy hq, and the second homotopy hr for every compatible a. Specialize hr to the given a and ha and return q, hq, hr a ha. The core signature is unchanged.

proof_origin.place: Forced caller adaptation to the common-witness theorem

theorem abelian_replacement_section_homotopies_core {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    {F : X.Modules} (I : InjectiveResolution F)
    (J : InjectiveResolution ((pushforward f).obj F)) (K : CochainComplex Y.Modules ℕ)
    (l : ((pushforward f).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℕ)).obj I.cocomplex ⟶ K)
    (hl : QuasiIso l) (β : J.cocomplex ⟶ K)
    (hβ : J.ι.f 0 ≫ β.f 0 = (pushforward f).map (I.ι.f 0) ≫ l.f 0)
    (a : ((moduleSections X).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℕ)).obj I.cocomplex ≅
      ((moduleSections Y).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℕ)).obj
        (((pushforward f).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℕ)).obj I.cocomplex))
    (ha : ∀ n : ℕ, a.inv.f n = (presheaf (I.cocomplex.X n)).map
      (eqToHom (by simp) : (⊤ : X.Opens) ⟶ f ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : Y.Opens)).op) :
    ∃ q : ((moduleSections Y).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℕ)).obj K ⟶
        ((abelianSections X).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℕ)).obj
          (standardAbelianResolution X F).cocomplex,
      Nonempty (Homotopy
        (((moduleSections Y).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℕ)).map β ≫ q)
        (counitSectionMap f F J)) ∧
      Nonempty (Homotopy
        ((a.hom ≫ ((moduleSections Y).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℕ)).map l) ≫ q)
        (((abelianSections X).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℕ)).map
          (forgottenResolutionMap X I)))
